address: Kandaharweg 9, Sankt Anton am Arlberg, 6580, Austria
bio: At an elevation of 2 085m, the gondola ride up here (free with your reservation) is even worthwhile for non-skiers. In addition to the breathtaking view, you can expect ambitious cuisine made from high-quality ingredients that doesn't limit itself to a specific style – rather it showcases traditional, regional, Mediterranean and even Asian influences. Appetising options include yellowfin tuna sashimi, Wiener schnitzel and risotto alla carbonara. The exceedingly friendly and charming waitstaff will be happy to recommend the right wine from the extensive list....
